// diagnostic

E0964

A length-changing method (`push`, `pop`, `insert`, `remove`, `clear`) was called on a fixed-size `[T#N]`.

What

A length-changing method (`push`, `pop`, `insert`, `remove`, `clear`) was called on a fixed-size `[T#N]`.

Why

The length of `[T#N]` is fixed at compile time and cannot change at runtime.

Fix

if you need a growable list, bind it with `:=` (e.g. `r := [...]`) so its length can change.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0964: tests/ui/fixed_list_no_grow.stderr.

Error [E0964]: `push` changes a list's length, but this is a fixed-size [Int#3]
  --> tests/ui/fixed_list_no_grow.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     result.push(99)
    |            ^^^^
 Why: the length of `[T#N]` is fixed at compile time and cannot change
 Fix: bind a growable list with `:=` (e.g. `r := [...]`) if you need to change its length
